item.title: Looking Back at My 2021 Tech Predictions: How the Future Arrived Right on Schedule
item.description: How accurate were tech predictions from 2021? Author Ng Fang Kiang reviews five years of rapid progress in AI, automation, spatial computing, and hardware, proving that the future arrived right on schedule.

item.title: That Time NVIDIA AI Followed 135 Accounts on Instagram - And I Was One of Them
item.description: Discover the surreal connection between a self-taught AI enthusiast and NVIDIA AI. Explore how achieving the #1 global spot in MIT’s DeepTraffic and a Udacity SDCND scholarship caught the attention of a tech giant.
